name: Droost Profiler
description: Self-contained request profiler for Droost: records database queries, timing, memory and response cacheability per HTTP request and exposes them to AI agents as read-only MCP tools. No external dependency.
project_description: Droost Profiler is a self-contained request profiler for Droost. A stack middleware (priority 210, just outside page_cache) records, per HTTP request, the database query log (via Database::startLog), wall-clock timing, peak memory, the matched route, HTTP status, and response cacheability (page-cache/dynamic-cache HIT/MISS, tags, contexts, max-age), persisting a profile row to the droost_profile table. Collection is OFF by default (droost_profiler.settings.enabled) and adds overhead, so it is intended for local development only. Two read-only MCP tools expose the data: droost_profile_list (recently profiled requests with url/method/min-duration filters) and droost_profile (one profile by token or the most recent, with slowest queries, duplicate-query groups, and queries aggregated by table). Stored URLs drop the query string and redact secret path segments (password-reset/account-cancel tokens); stored query detail is capped and truncated to bound the row size. It is built without Webprofiler or the Devel suite, has no external dependency, provides a restrict-access permission (administer droost profiler) and a settings form, and depends only on droost. Local development only.
